WITH qualifying_schools AS (
    SELECT
        f."County Name" AS county_name,
        f."Charter School (Y/N)" AS charter_indicator,
        ROUND(100.0 * f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0), 2) AS free_meal_pct,
        ROUND(100.0 * f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0), 2) AS frpm_pct,
        s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite AS sat_score
    FROM main.frpm AS f
    LEFT JOIN main.satscores AS s ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
    WHERE f."County Code" = (
        SELECT anchor."County Code"
        FROM main.frpm AS anchor
        WHERE anchor.CDSCode = '01612590125716'
    )
      AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500
      AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
), decimal_input AS (
SELECT 'free' AS group_id, CAST(ROUND(free_meal_pct * 100) AS INTEGER) AS scaled_value FROM qualifying_schools
UNION ALL SELECT 'frpm', CAST(ROUND(frpm_pct * 100) AS INTEGER) FROM qualifying_schools
UNION ALL SELECT 'sat', sat_score * 100 FROM qualifying_schools
), decimal_bounds AS (
  SELECT group_id, scaled_value,
    COUNT(scaled_value) OVER g AS n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN scaled_value IS NOT NULL AND typeof(scaled_value) <> 'integer' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER g AS invalid_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN typeof(scaled_value) = 'integer' AND scaled_value NOT BETWEEN -90071992547409 AND 90071992547409 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER g AS oversized_count,
    TOTAL(CASE WHEN typeof(scaled_value) = 'integer' AND scaled_value BETWEEN -90071992547409 AND 90071992547409 THEN ABS(scaled_value) ELSE 0 END) OVER g AS abs_total
  FROM decimal_input

    SUM(CASE WHEN invalid_count = 0 AND oversized_count = 0
      AND abs_total <= 90071992547409 AND n <= 90071992547409
      THEN scaled_value END) AS scaled_sum
  FROM decimal_bounds
  GROUP BY group_id
), decimal_fraction AS (
  SELECT group_id, n, invalid_count, status,
    scaled_sum * 100 AS numerator, n * 100 AS denominator
  FROM decimal_totals
), decimal_rounded AS (
  SELECT group_id, n, invalid_count, status,

WITH qualifying_schools AS (
    SELECT
        f."County Name" AS county_name,
        f."Charter School (Y/N)" AS charter_indicator,
        ROUND(100.0 * f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0), 2) AS free_meal_pct,
        ROUND(100.0 * f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0), 2) AS frpm_pct,
        s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite AS sat_score
    FROM main.frpm AS f
    LEFT JOIN main.satscores AS s ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
    WHERE f."County Code" = (
        SELECT anchor."County Code"
        FROM main.frpm AS anchor
        WHERE anchor.CDSCode = '01612590125716'
    )
      AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500
      AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
)
SELECT
    county_name,
    COUNT(*) AS school_count,
    ROUND(AVG(free_meal_pct), 2) AS avg_free_meal_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(frpm_pct), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN charter_indicator = 1 THEN 1 END) AS charter_school_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN charter_indicator = 0 THEN 1 END) AS non_charter_school_count,
    ROUND(AVG(sat_score), 2) AS avg_sat_score
FROM qualifying_schools
GROUP BY county_name
LIMIT 1
